solution_summary: Mars Science & Diagnostics, a Healthcare organization in United States, modernized this document processing workload with Azure, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Kubernetes Service, and Azure Cosmos DB. So, the company looked to support its development efforts by using components from the Microsoft Azure AI model catalog, making it easier to accelerate the creation of its RapidRead solution. Azure provides the scalable cloud foundation hosting the customer’s modernized applications, data, and AI workloads. Azure Machine Learning trains, manages, and deploys machine learning models used in the production workflow. Azure Kubernetes Service runs the containerized services and data-processing workloads that need elastic compute at scale. Operational data and user activity flow through Azure, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure Kubernetes Service, where the platform processes information and serves outputs back to business users.
